pages.subject: Kobold Warrior
pages.picture: A small scaly kobold warrior in a tight trapped stone corridor cackles as a tripwire snaps at ankle height. Short snout, horns or cranial ridges, long tail, spear and slatted shield. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, visible tripwire and a covered pit lid. Closed far door. Outline art only, large colorable shapes.

pages.subject: Kobold Shrine-Keeper
pages.picture: A small kobold shrine-keeper in a low cave shrine raises a copper coin as an offering. Same kobold family: snout, ridges, tail. A crude stone altar, a few large coins, one dragon-skull prop. Cave ceiling, simple walls, large floor slabs, closed doorway. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Goblin Minion
pages.picture: A small goblin minion runs through a dungeon kitchen with a stolen ham under one arm. Big pointed ears, long nose, scrawny body. Hanging pots as large shapes, a table, a closed pantry door, stone ceiling and floor. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Goblin Warrior
pages.picture: Use data/director/I-04.json. Narrow corridor, kicking a hanging lantern.

pages.subject: Goblin Boss
pages.picture: A squat goblin boss stands on a chest in a cave hall and points a bent sword. Big ears, long nose, patched armor as large plates. Improvised throne of crates behind him. Cave ceiling, closed doors, large floor slabs. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Hobgoblin Warrior
pages.picture: Use data/director/I-06.json. Barracks tunnel, shield-wall drill.

pages.subject: Hobgoblin Captain
pages.picture: Use data/director/I-07.json. Locked soldier-face redraw.

pages.subject: Bugbear Warrior
pages.picture: Use data/director/I-08.json. Ceiling-crack ambush, no black void.

pages.subject: Bugbear Stalker
pages.picture: A tall bugbear stalker creeps in a low crawlway, dragging a sack and raising one finger for silence. Large fur clumps, blunt snout, short pointed ears, long arms. Low stone ceiling, tight walls, large floor slabs, closed hatch ahead. Outline art only, no black blobs.

pages.subject: Ogre
pages.picture: A huge clumsy ogre is wedged on a too-small spiral dungeon stair. Thick belly, tiny-looking head, big hands, simple club. Tight stairwell with stone ceiling, inner pillar, large steps. Outline art only, big body plates, no black fills.

pages.subject: Ogre Zombie
pages.picture: An ogre zombie shuffles down a cramped dungeon stair with chains dragging. Same huge body, slack jaw, tattered wrappings as large shapes. Dark stairwell with ceiling, walls, large steps, closed door below. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Troll
pages.picture: A long-limbed troll sits by a cave fire pit watching a wound close on its arm. Long rubbery arms, long nose, warty skin in large patches, not a bugbear. Cave ceiling, fire pit as a colorable bowl, simple rocks, closed tunnel mouth. Outline art only, no filled fire black.

pages.subject: Troll Limb
pages.picture: A severed troll arm crawls across bare dungeon flagstones toward a dropped axe. The arm is large and obvious, with claws and a closing cut. Empty hall with ceiling, walls, large slabs, the axe as one big shape. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Darkmantle
pages.picture: A darkmantle peels off a limestone cave ceiling above a lantern. It looks like a living stalactite with a toothy underside and spreading flaps, not a bat and not an octopus. Cave ceiling full of simple stalactites, lantern on the floor as a large shape, closed tunnel. Outline art only, no black cave void.

pages.subject: Stirges
pages.picture: Several large mosquito-bat stirges crowd a dungeon cell around a sleeping prisoner on a bench. Each stirge is a fat body, long needle snout, and simple wing shapes. Cell bars, stone ceiling, closed door, large floor. Outline art only. Prisoner is a simple clothed shape, not gory.

pages.subject: Giant Bat
pages.picture: A giant bat hangs above an underground river, wings partly wrapped. One huge bat, big ears, simple wing membranes as large color regions. Cave ceiling, river bank stones, closed tunnel. Outline art only, no black water fill.

pages.subject: Bat Swarm
pages.picture: A swarm of bats explodes upward from a vertical dungeon well shaft. Draw the swarm as groups of large simple bats, not hundreds of specks. Well rim, stone shaft walls, ceiling opening as broken stone you can color. Outline art only, no black shaft void.

pages.subject: Giant Rat
pages.picture: A giant rat defends a nest among burst sacks in a collapsed dungeon pantry. Big rat body, round ears, thick tail, not a mouse. Sacks as large shapes, stone ceiling, closed door. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Rat Swarm
pages.picture: A rat swarm pours through a dungeon floor grate like water. Draw several overlapping large rats, not tiny dots. Grate as a simple grid with big openings, stone floor, wall, ceiling. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Giant Centipede
pages.picture: A giant centipede uncoils around an old bone in a catacomb coffin niche. Long segmented body with large simple segments, many legs as simple strokes, not hair. Niche, coffin edge, stone ceiling. Outline art only.
must_not_be: a millipede with tiny hair legs

pages.subject: Giant Fire Beetle
pages.picture: A giant fire beetle lights an abandoned mine tunnel with two large glowing glands on its body drawn as empty colorable ovals, not black. Big beetle shell, six legs, simple antennae. Timber props, tunnel ceiling, closed mine door. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Giant Spider
pages.picture: A giant spider waits at the center of a large web in a dungeon hall. One big spider, round abdomen, eight simple legs, not a mass of hair. Web is a few large strands making colorable gaps. Hall ceiling, closed door. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Giant Wolf Spider
pages.picture: A giant wolf spider is flattened on the ceiling above a treasure chest, watching. Longer legs, no big web filling the page. Chest is a large closed box. Hall ceiling, walls, floor. Outline art only.
must_not_be: the same web spider as I-22

pages.subject: Gelatinous Cube
pages.picture: A gelatinous cube fills a ten-foot dressed-stone corridor and slides forward. The cube is a big square outline with a few bones and one key floating inside as separate colorable shapes. Corridor ceiling, walls, floor. No gray jelly fill. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Black Pudding
pages.picture: A black pudding climbs through a dungeon cistern grate, corroding the bars. Draw it as a thick amoeba outline with a few large lobes, white inside to color, not a solid black blob. Cistern stones, grate, ceiling. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Ochre Jelly
pages.picture: An ochre jelly has split on a dungeon stair; two halves crawl upward. Two large amoeba outlines, white interiors. Stair, ceiling, rail-free stone. Outline art only, no brown fill.

pages.subject: Mimic Chest
pages.picture: A treasure-chest mimic opens a toothy mouth around a reaching hand in a vault. Chest body, lid teeth, one hidden eye, stubby feet. Vault ceiling, simple shelves, closed door. The hand is a simple gloved shape. Outline art only.
must_not_be: a monster mouth with no chest

pages.subject: Mimic Door
pages.picture: A door mimic in a torch-lit hall shows a tongue-handle and a hidden eye. Still reads as a wooden door first. Hall ceiling, walls, floor, one torch as a large shape with no black flame fill. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Animated Armor
pages.picture: A suit of animated armor steps down from a display pedestal in a hall of pedestals. Empty helmet visor as a colorable opening, large plate shapes, no person inside. Hall ceiling, other closed armor on pedestals as simple silhouettes. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Flying Sword
pages.picture: A flying sword orbits a cracked pillar at throat height in a dungeon rotunda. One large sword, simple tassels. Round room, dome ceiling, floor, closed arch. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Rug of Smothering
pages.picture: A rug of smothering rears up from a noble crypt floor to wrap a victim. The rug is a large patterned rectangle coming alive, pattern as big shapes not tiny ornaments. Crypt ceiling, sarcophagus, closed door. Victim is a simple shape. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Gargoyle
pages.picture: A stone gargoyle on a dungeon gate begins to move; one wing lifts. Horns, wings, claws, stone body plates. Gate arch, closed portcullis as large bars, courtyard floor, ceiling of the gatehouse. Outline art only.
must_not_be: a statue that stays fully frozen with no motion

pages.subject: Labyrinth Minotaur
pages.picture: A living minotaur fills a maze intersection with an axe ready. Bull head, humanoid muscular body, large axe, nose ring as one shape. Identical stone corridors left and right, ceiling, floor. Closed false doors. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Minotaur Skeleton
pages.picture: A minotaur skeleton turns a dark labyrinth corner. Clear skull with horns, ribcage as large loops, axe. Corridor ceiling, walls, floor. Outline art only, bones are outlines not black fills.

pages.subject: Roper
pages.picture: A roper disguised as a stalagmite strikes with a few thick tendrils. Rocky conical body, one toothy maw, large simple tendrils, not a dozen hair lines. Stalagmite cavern, ceiling, floor. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Cloaker
pages.picture: A cloaker peels off a wall hook in a dungeon antechamber like a living cloak. Inside of the cloak shows a face and tail. Hook, wall, ceiling, closed door, floor. Outline art only, cloak interior is white to color.

pages.subject: Grick
pages.picture: A grick emerges from collapsed tunnel rubble, tentacles around a central beak. Worm-like body, four large tentacles, hooked beak. Rubble as big stones, tunnel ceiling. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Ankheg
pages.picture: An ankheg bursts upward through an earthen tunnel floor. Long segmented insect body, big mandibles, six legs, simple carapace plates. Burst soil as large clods, tunnel ceiling. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Bulette
pages.picture: A bulette dorsal fin cuts loose earth before the armored head surfaces. Land-shark plates as large armor shapes, tiny eyes, wide mouth. Cavern of loose soil, ceiling, rocks. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Rust Monster
pages.picture: A rust monster feeds on a pile of ruined metal in an abandoned armory alcove. Four legs, long tail, two antennae, armored bug body. Not a dragon. Weapons as large simple shapes already notched. Alcove ceiling, closed door. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Otyugh
pages.picture: An otyugh rises from a refuse pit with three tentacles and eyestalks searching. Fat potato body, three legs, two large tentacles, one smaller stalk. Pit rim, dungeon stones, ceiling. Refuse as large sacks and bones, not tiny trash. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Gibbering Mouther
pages.picture: A gibbering mouther churns in a flooded dungeon cell, many mouths as large simple ovals. Amorphous body outline, white interior. Ripples as line, not black water. Cell bars, ceiling. Outline art only. Keep it all-ages, not gory.
must_not_be: a pile of human faces in detail

pages.subject: Basilisk
pages.picture: A low eight-legged basilisk stares in an underground statue gallery as a small creature petrifies into a simple statue pose. Thick lizard body, eight legs, ridge along the back. Gallery ceiling, a few large statues. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Cockatrice
pages.picture: A cockatrice in an improvised dungeon henhouse raises wings beside a petrified mouse. Rooster body, bat-ish wings, lizard tail, beak. Nest boxes as large shapes, ceiling, closed door. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Purple Worm
pages.picture: A purple worm's circular maw fills a mine shaft. Huge ring of teeth as a colorable rim, segmented body disappearing down the tunnel. Mine timbers, shaft walls. Interior of the mouth is white shapes to color, not a black hole.

pages.subject: Drider
pages.picture: A drider hangs in a webbed underground chapel aiming downward. Drow-elf torso on a giant spider body. Chapel arch, simple altar, ceiling webs as large strands. Outline art only, no tiny hair.

pages.subject: Behir
pages.picture: A behir coils around a crystal column in a crystal cavern, mouth open. Long many-legged crocodilian body, two large horns. Crystals as big geometric shapes. Cave ceiling. Lightning is a simple zigzag line, not a black bolt fill.

pages.subject: Shrieker Fungus
pages.picture: A shrieker fungus in an underground mushroom hall has its gill-mouth open in a shriek. Tall mushroom with a wide cap as large color regions. Other simple mushrooms, cave ceiling, floor. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Violet Fungus
pages.picture: A violet fungus in the same fungal cavern reaches tendrils toward a dropped torch. Pad-like cap, four large tendrils, not hair. Torch as a colorable shape with no black flame. Ceiling, floor, other simple mushrooms. Outline art only.

pages.subject: Lich
pages.picture: A lich guards a phylactery in a deep underground vault while casting. Skeletal face, tattered robes as large folds, one phylactery box on a pedestal. Vault ceiling, sealed door, a few big runes as empty shapes with no readable letters. Outline art only. All-ages, not rotting gore.
must_not_be: a generic skeleton with no robes
